thread.topic: My admin application for the knife server.

posts.subject: My admin application for the knife server.
posts.bodyHtml:
Dear Dream community, this is my first admin application for the knife server. Thank you for reading it. Let's begin...



What is your name/nickname?



My name in real life is Petr and I am from Czech Republic. In the game you will recognize me by name Thorin Pikachu.



How old are you?



I am 18 years old but I am turning 19 in february.


Why do you want to become an admin?

The reason is that I really love this server. It is because I used to play CS 1.6 knife server (also was admin there) for almost 2 years. Then the server was deleted without any warning and I was very sad about that. Then I got my hands on CS GO. I was trying to find a good knife server there but I wasn't succesful. But one day I found Dream server and I fell in love. My most favorite gamemode + awesome people that I have met so far... True love was born 😄 So I told myself that I want to help this server with problems (cheaters, toxic and offensive people, etc.) and this is the best way.



For how long have you been playing on Dream servers? (so far)



I have around 7000 Stammpoints on the knife server and on other servers it can be around 500 together.


What are your hobbies?



My hobbies are PC gaming, guitar and cajon playing, going out with my "crew" and that is probably it 🙂 .



Do you have any expriences with being admin?



As I said before I was an admin on cs 1.6 knife server for a year. I have learnt there how to act in some situations, for example I know how to prevent or end an argue and how to calm people down. But I am not gonna lie, my admin skills are a bit rusty 😄



What is your activity on servers?



I am not gonna write a precise schedule of my activity but I can tell you approx. amounts of time:

From monday to thursday I am on PC between 15:00 and 17:00 (few minutes here and there) and then in evening from approx. 20:30 to 1:00 let's say. (I am saying that I am on PC not that I am on servers at this time. But I will be there at least half of this time and more if needed)


On friday I can be here from 13:00 to 17:00 and in evening same or longer than during previous days.


Weekends are complicated and I can't tell you time but I can be here at least on sunday evening. (depends on my current situation).



Player insults other player/s, what will you do?



In the beginnig I will investigate what is going on there. I will ask both sides for their opinion. Then I will make conclusion based on what I have heard or read (or what other players told me). I will demand an apology and if it won't happen or it will be repeated I will mute/kick/ban (for appropriate amount of time). Of course this is the last option. Before that I will try to talk to offender and take him to the right side 🙂 . But you can't help everybody.



Your strenghts and weaknesses?



Strenghts:
I am mature when it is needed (not that I not mature all the time, but when I talk to friends I am easing on the maturity a bit)
I can speak and write english well
I am talkative
I have analytical thinking (good for solving problems)
Nothing will offend/trigger me (I mean it. If you say you wish my mother a cancer I won't be triggered, I will just make opinion on you)(Dont' wish anybody a cancer by the way...)
I have a sense of humor


Weaknesses:
Activity on TeamSpeak (can be easily fixed)
Can't speak german (though I understand it a bit)
Forum activity (to be correct I am active, but I just read, I don't reply too often because usually my opinion has been said by somebody else already.)
Don't have exprience with CS GO admin commands)


As a conclusion I must say that I think I am a good candidate for becoming an admin.



My last words will be words of gratitude.


Thank you all for spending your precious time on reading and commenting on this application. I appreciate it. And I will see you on Dream servers as an admin or as a player. Bye

Hello @Thorin Pikachu


I'm very pleased that you want to support the admin team of Dream, through out this you will see some Pro's and Con's stated by me, so without taking any more time let's get into my points.


Starting with the Pros:
- You are active on the game server which is very important.
- Your stamm points are more than enough.
- Hobbies are great, I like them 🙂
- Your activity hours are good enough, don't worry that school is in the way.
- You are nice to people that you want them to apology for insulting players.
- You're more than mature for this position, I have never seen anything bad or negative about you.
- Your English is good and understandable also in game we can easily understand you.
- You know the rules pretty much well enough.


Moving onto Neutral points:
- Push your activity on forum (not really write something but just be active)
- Push your activity on ts3.


Negative points:
- I have to say you're the first person I have no negative points about because I never seen you break a rule.



In my overall opinion I'm saying YES, you're more than suitable for the position and I believe you can achieve great.


I wish you best in your application and succession.
@OxygeN Thank you for your support, it means a lot 🙂
@OxygeN says all i saw you on the Knife Server and i think you will be a good and friendly admin.

Zitat von OxygeN
